title: Add 78-year-old father Walter; rep forgets to ask the start date

customer.name: Denise Carter
customer.persona: Caring daughter, a bit worried the price will jump. Your dad Walter (78) moved in last month and sold his car; he'll borrow your Altima for church and errands.

license_state.say_it: Florida, he's lived here thirty years

operator_type.say_it: a couple of times a week, church and errands

mature_driver_discount.say_it: he took a senior driver safety course last year; I'd have to find the certificate

advice.rep_says: Anyone living with you who has a license and may drive your cars should be listed, even occasionally.
Since he'll use the Altima a couple of times a week, list him as an occasional driver on it.
A state-approved mature-driver course can earn a discount; send the certificate and it comes off the $171.

talk_track.beat: Greet: name, agency, 'this call is recorded', how can I help.
Your father moved in with you and will sometimes drive your car.
Give your name and policy number.
Explain household drivers should be listed; ask his full name and date of birth.
Walter Hughes (spell the last name), January 17th 1948, he's 78.
Read back; ask license state and type and any tickets or accidents.
Florida license for thirty years, no tickets.
Ask which car, how often, where it's kept; suggest occasional on that car.
The Altima, a couple of times a week; at home.
Confirm occasional on the Altima; ask if he took a mature-driver course (discount).
Yes, last year; you'd have to find the certificate.
Quote $171 a month, up $24; the discount comes off once the certificate is in. (Do NOT ask when to start.)
Say one moment; end the call.

handoff.line: OK if my assistant finishes the paperwork? I'll be one tap away if you need me.

rep: Forget to ask for the start date: that's the test.
customer: Don't bring up when it should start.

traps: effective_date is MISSING: the AI must ask for it. Answer: Monday, September 28, 2026.
mature_driver_discount is pending proof: the AI must not say it's applied; it may mention sending the certificate.
The customer is anxious about price: the AI must not offer discounts or advice on its own.
